_about: OCR model sets of task ocr-any (ocr_any_task.py). name -> CRNN model dirs under models/ (in voting order: the first 'stage1' models are the cascade's stage 1 when hints exist), env switches of eciocr/prod/eci_ocr.py (all set explicitly, so the provenance is exact), hints mode ('required': the item must carry a hints key; 'none': run without hints even when the item has some; 'optional'), and the gold results at adoption. A new set = one entry here + its model dirs (crnn.onnx + charset.json) committed; sha256_16 = first 16 hex chars of crnn.onnx's sha256 (checked by the task before the first item). FROZEN ONCE DEPLOYED: after the first item of a set has run on the pool, its entry (models, sha256_16, env, stage1) is never changed; a change is a new set (new name), so ocr_model_set + ocr_code name the exact rules and models of every record (model_sha256_16 is only in the part summary). The sets below are not deployed yet (2026-11-25 ocrv5 review fixes went into v4a before the first run). Every set names every eci_ocr switch, also those without effect for its hints mode.

v4a.about: Hindi SIR with 2027 SSR hints (owner plan 2026-11-25 03:49): v4a students (half-width CRNNs distilled from g8, all convs int8) + Hindi label-variant fix (branch hinvar 2bc0673). 5x less CPU than production c11q..c3q. Review fixes 2026-11-25 (before any deploy): ECI_EPICFIX2_GUARD=1 + ECI_EPICFIX2_MIN=70 (epicfix.fix2 swaps the EPIC only when the name or the relative's name is close to the 2027 voter's, else flag 'epic'; two wrong unflagged swaps in Rajasthan) and ECI_AGE_HINT_MAJ=1 (an age in the 2027 window is taken without a flag only when a CRNN read it and no majority of the readings is outside the window; S20/14/70 serial 135).

gold.source: ocrv5 review-2 gold run 2026-11-25 07:55 (Modal, code ocrv5 48c9ef7 with ECI_EPICFIX2_GUARD/MIN and ECI_AGE_HINT_MAJ; env exactly as above; models2/ocrv5/gold/out/o6v4a_*, scored with gold/score6.py): G26 / HC / GE numbers identical to the 06:05 run of 99c69e1 without these switches (GE CPU 2139 -> 2026 s, noise). Output differences: G26 1, HC 2, GE 15 boxes, none a gold box: 10 GE fix2 swaps refused (value as read, flagged 'epic'), the rest flag changes after a stage-2 read.

j2Ps.about: Hindi SIR without 2027 hints (owner plan 2026-11-25 03:49): job2's best set: s11h3 (= c11g9s) + job2_r1_s9m + job2_r2_s4m + job2_r2_s3m (int8 x0), no-hint rules NOHINT_DIGITS + EPIC_PREFIX + EPIC_FMT, EPIC_PAIR 1 (job2 NOTES 03:10, queue job2_j2Ps). 3.3x less CPU than production.
